scenes.headline: Context Managers
scenes.subtitle: Guaranteed setup and teardown
scenes.narration: Context managers guarantee that resources like files, database connections, and locks are always cleaned up, even when the code using them fails partway through.

scenes.headline: The with protocol
scenes.narration: Any object that implements two dunder methods can drive a with block. The __enter__ method acquires the resource and hands back a handle, while __exit__ releases it when the block ends. Crucially, __exit__ runs even if an exception is raised inside the body, which is what makes cleanup reliable. This same protocol powers file objects, threading locks, and database transactions.

scenes.headline: A class-based manager
scenes.narration: This Timer implements the protocol directly. Its __enter__ records a start time and returns the object itself as the handle. Its __exit__ receives details about any exception that occurred and prints the elapsed time, running whether the block finished cleanly or blew up. Wrapping any code in a with Timer block now measures it automatically.

scenes.headline: The contextmanager shortcut
scenes.narration: When writing a full class feels heavy, the contextmanager decorator lets you build one from a simple generator. Everything before the yield is setup, the yielded value becomes the handle the with block receives, and everything after runs as teardown. Putting the close inside a finally guarantees the file is released even if the body raises.

scenes.headline: with lifecycle
scenes.narration: Entering a with statement first runs __enter__ to acquire the resource, then executes the indented body using it. No matter how that body ends, whether it completes normally or an exception propagates out, __exit__ is guaranteed to run and perform the cleanup before control leaves the block.

scenes.text: Put cleanup in __exit__ or after yield so resources release even when the body raises.
scenes.narration: Place your cleanup in __exit__ or after the yield, and context managers turn fragile manual teardown into a guarantee the language enforces for you.
